title: Wang Mang is killed as his Xin dynasty falls
summary: Rebel forces broke into Chang'an and killed the emperor Wang Mang in his palace, ending his Xin dynasty.
reason: Wang Mang's radical reforms, floods of the Yellow River and famine provoked massive revolts such as the Red Eyebrows and the Lulin.
significance: His fall led to the restoration of the Han dynasty as the Eastern Han.
